title: Shared 2 Hour September Sunset Cruise from Gig Harbor
includes: Gratuities are not included in price.
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This cruise takes you through the heart of Puget Sound hailing out of Gig Harbor, WA. Our cruise is available to individual travelers rather than groups only. Our vessel, "RIVIERA" is a restored, US Coast Guard certified, classic Northwest built charter boat. She and her captain and crew are steeped in Puget Sound legacy and experience. This smooth-water cruise takes us under two major suspension bridges. Wildlife ranges from seagulls to Bald Eagles, seals and sea lions. Can't miss Mt. Rainier and the Olympic Mountain range unimpeded except for some clouds. You can bring-your-own snacks and drinks. This is an interactive trip where we candidly and casually interpret our surroundings. There is plenty of time on this cruise where you are left to enjoy the cruise without interruption. We will talk with you and answer your questions along the way. (Senior Age is 62. Cruise is recommended for ages 10 and above.)
